fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 1998 Lund 1800 Fisherman aluminum fishing boat with motor and trailer.
findings: Painted aluminum hull sides (tan and navy) look fairly dull with little reflection in the side shots
Some light spotting and grime visible on the tan lower hull near the stern on the port side
Black outboard cowling and lower unit look faded and chalky in the rear view
Rear transom area below the splash well shows dirt and discoloration
Interior carpet and seats look reasonably clean but carpet appears a bit dusty in the rear view
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1998 Lund 1800 Fisherman. It looks like a solid boat, though the painted hull sides look a bit dull in the photos and the black Johnson cowling has some fading. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including a hull buff and wax and a cleanup of the motor cover and interior. Would you like a quote?
